messages:
Anya: New canary batch (raven-lite-int8) shows odd toolcall parse spikes when retrying quickly. attaching example fragment.
Ravi: paste the minimal broken output?
Anya: `{"tool":"annotate","args":[{"text":"find references` (truncated) — missing closing braces.
Toby: looks like stream splice mid-token. our retry stitches two byte sequences without a delimiter. quantized models (int8) sometimes split tokens differently.
Anya: current route TTL=140ms, retry backoff 200ms. retries often reattach to a different replica.
Ravi: quick fix idea: seam v2 — emit `\n<SEAM_v2>\n` on retry boundaries and teach parser to treat it as a join point; also include a replica-id header.
Keiko: also note difference between int4 and int8: int4 had fewer splices in last run, might be tokenizer-related. log tokenizer offsets when parse fails.
CI-Bot: canary/raven-lite-int8 #89: parse_failures=24/600, retry_rate=4.1%, p99=290ms. artifacts s3://ci/canary/89/
Anya: action list: (A) add seam_v2 injection on retry (Ravi), (B) emit replica_id+retry_idx in parse telemetry (Toby), (C) enable opt-in NDJSON-fallback per-route (Keiko), (D) add tokenizer-offset dump on failure (Anya).
Ravi: I'll push a tiny patch to inject seam_v2 and a parser update that looks for `<SEAM_v2>` and attempts safe stitching.
Toby: telemetry change: include replica_id, attempt_num, seam_injected boolean. also record raw_fragments for manual triage.
Keiko: NDJSON-fallback must be off by default; QA will review cases where fallback used. I'll add a dashboard for fallback_count per-model.
Anya: repro command: `./bin/canary_sim --model raven-lite-int8 --seed 99 --ttl 140 --requests 1000` then `grep PARSE_FAIL canary.log`. I'll attach a snippet in the CL.
CI-Bot: CL 4710 created: seam_v2 injection + telemetry fields. running canary.
Ravi: note -- seam token should be short ASCII to avoid tokenizer-related token boundaries. using `<SEAM_v2>` fits.
Toby: agreed. keep retry budget conservative during canary to avoid noise.
Anya: thanks team, we'll check results after CI completes. :sparkles:
